entities.name: Basilica of Immaculate Conception, Phu Nhai

entities.summary: The Basilica of Immaculate Conception in Phu Nhai is a neo-Gothic Roman Catholic basilica in Phú Nhai, Xuân Trường, Nam Định, Vietnam. It is dedicated to the Blessed Virgin Mary under its namesake title.
